content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overshoot true outcomes by 5-10% due to a structural upward bias.", "Apply a mean-reversion correction factor of -6% when sentiment is high (>=0.8) but recent history shows declining prices.", "Reduce forecasted values by 4% if the model predicts a rise while the last three historical days show downward momentum.", "Ignore positive sentiment signals during bearish trends where true outcomes fall below 75 despite high predicted values.", "Correct upward forecasts by subtracting the difference between the current price and the average of the last five days.", "When sentiment is neutral (0.33-0.67) and prices are volatile, reduce forecast accuracy confidence by 20%.", "Reverse positive momentum in predictions if the true outcome from the previous period was significantly lower than the model's own forecast."] }
